profile.headline: Founder | E-commerce Performance ⚡ | Web SME | AI/ML Strategist & International Speaker | Technical Leader delivering global impact
profile.summary:
Globant leverages over two years of my expertise as a Product Owner to enhance the e-commerce web performance of Dick's Sporting Goods. My role focuses on performance optimization, strategic development, and assessments while serving as a Web Subject Matter Expert specializing in Angular and React. Through collaboration, our team delivers tailored solutions that elevate user experiences and drive measurable results.  

With a strong foundation in software engineering and team leadership, my previous projects at Google Verily enabled efficient health data exchange and testing automation. By integrating tools like Golang, Angular, and Cypress, I contributed to impactful system improvements. I am motivated by a commitment to technical excellence and fostering innovation in every project I support.

I have autonomously mastered the art of abstract painting, honed the craft of brewing beer, and proudly own four Xoloitzcuintli dogs.🎨🍻🐶

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer | Java Backend, Google Store
positions.description:
Developing and coding mission-critical backend services for the Google Store, focusing on core infrastructure for checkout, shopping cart, and payment processing systems. 

Writing robust server-side microservices and designing REST/gRPC APIs to drive complex data transformations, utilizing Google's internal technology stack to ensure high availability and scalability. 

Championing hands-on AI-assisted development by leveraging Google AI tools in daily coding workflows to optimize engineering velocity and system performance

positions.title: AI Pod Architect | Web Foundation SME |  SME for Dick's Sporting Goods ecommerce
positions.description:
I manage the technical direction of a Tier-1 e-commerce ecosystem, balancing daily stability with new engineering initiatives. My work centers on "Run the Business" (RTB) operations while building a roadmap for AI integration to help the team move faster.

By modernizing CI/CD infrastructure and setting up performance governance, I’ve removed deployment bottlenecks and improved Core Web Vitals for a massive user base.
